parameters.jsonBody:
={{
  {
    model: $json.model,

    input:
      "You are the Literature Expert for a research system involving " +
      "smartwatch haptic feedback.\n\n" +

      "You MUST search the configured literature vector store before answering. " +
      "Use only evidence retrieved from the uploaded academic sources. " +
      "Do not invent papers, authors, publication years, findings, or citations. " +
      "Clearly distinguish direct evidence from design interpretation. " +
      "Do not claim that a recommended haptic configuration is universally safe " +
      "or clinically validated unless the retrieved literature explicitly supports it.\n\n" +

      "Relevant areas include haptic feedback, tactile displays, tactons, " +
      "sensory substitution, interoception, biofeedback, wearable feedback, " +
      "thermal perception, urgency perception, vibration timing, intensity, " +
      "duration, repetition, and feedback burden.\n\n" +

      "Researcher question:\n" +
      $json.message +

      "\n\nSelected use case: " +
      ($json.usecase_name ?? "not selected") +

      "\nAdditional context:\n" +
      JSON.stringify($json.context ?? {}, null, 2),

    tools: [
      {
        type: "file_search",
        vector_store_ids: [$json.vector_store_id],
        max_num_results: 8
      }
    ],

    tool_choice: {
      type: "file_search"
    },

    include: [
      "file_search_call.results"
    ]
  }
}}
